databaseDescription: Football analytics database with Spain La Liga (1st division) historical data (2005/2006–2024/2025) sourced from Sofascore via ScraperFC.

football_players.name: football_players
football_players.description: Professional football players who appeared in La Liga or La Liga 2 between 2005/06 and 2024/25. One document per unique player.

sofascore_id.description: Unique numeric player identifier from Sofascore

updated_at.description: Last time this document was updated by the scraper

football_standings.name: football_standings
football_standings.description: Final league standings per team per season. PRIMARY collection for historical classification queries. Contains 'points', 'rank' (final position), 'wins', 'draws', 'losses', 'goals_scored', 'goals_conceded', 'goal_diff'. Covers La Liga 14/15 to 24/25 and Segunda División 14/15 to 22/23 (418 documents). Use this for: points by season, final position, league table, team history. Filter by team_name using $in with both old CSV names and official Sofascore names (see query rules).

football_player_stats.name: football_player_stats
football_player_stats.description: Season-total statistics for top scorers in La Liga. CRITICAL WARNINGS: (1) match_id is always 0 — these are season totals, NOT per-match stats. (2) ONLY goals and assists contain real data. minutes_played, yellow_cards, red_cards, tackles, interceptions, shots_total, shots_on_target, key_passes, ball_recoveries are ALL 0 in EVERY document. xg and sofascore_rating are NULL in EVERY document. (3) Only covers seasons 23/24 and 24/25, top 100/57 scorers each. DO NOT use for cards, fouls, tackles, defensive stats, or minutes — use football_matches instead.

ball_recoveries.description: Balls recovered in this match — key metric for defensive performance

key_passes.description: Key passes (passes leading to a shot) in this match

minutes_played.description: Minutes the player was on the pitch in this match

season_year.description: Numeric start year — use for range queries (e.g. season_year: { $gte: 2020 })

shots_on_target.description: Shots on target in this match

sofascore_rating.description: Sofascore match rating on a 1–10 scale. Null if unavailable.

team_id.description: Sofascore team ID the player represented in this match

updated_at.description: Last time this document was updated

xg.description: Expected goals for this player in this match. Null before 2014/15.

football_matches.name: football_matches
football_matches.description: Individual match records for La Liga and La Liga 2. One document per match with score, xG, and match metadata. xG (expected goals) is only available from the 2014/15 season onward.

sofascore_id.description: Unique numeric match identifier from Sofascore

away_score.description: Goals scored by the away team

away_team_id.description: Sofascore ID of the away team (references football_teams.sofascore_id)

away_xg.description: Expected goals (xG) for the away team. Null for seasons before 2014/15.

date.description: UTC date and time when the match kicked off

home_score.description: Goals scored by the home team

home_team_id.description: Sofascore ID of the home team (references football_teams.sofascore_id)

home_xg.description: Expected goals (xG) for the home team. Null for seasons before 2014/15.

season_year.description: Numeric start year of the season (e.g. 2023 for 2023/24) — use this field for range queries

updated_at.description: Last time this document was updated by the scraper

football_team_stats.name: football_team_stats
football_team_stats.description: CRITICAL LIMITATIONS — DO NOT USE FOR XG OR ADVANCED STATS: Only covers 2 seasons (23/24 and 24/25), 20 La Liga teams only (40 total documents). Does NOT have a 'points' field. total_xg, xg_per_match, avg_ball_possession, total_shots, shots_on_target are NULL in ALL 40 documents — NEVER use this collection for xG analysis, use football_matches.home_xg/away_xg instead. For xG overperformance (goals vs expected goals), use football_matches grouped by home_team_name/away_team_name. For historical points, classification position, wins/draws/losses across all seasons (14/15 to 24/25), use football_standings instead.

season_year.description: Numeric start year — use for range queries

avg_ball_possession.description: Average ball possession percentage across the season

goals_conceded.description: Total goals conceded across the season

goals_scored.description: Total goals scored across the season

matches_played.description: Total matches played in the season

shots_on_target.description: Total shots on target across all matches

total_xg.description: Sum of expected goals (xG) across all matches. Null before 2014/15.

updated_at.description: Last time this document was updated

xg_per_match.description: Average expected goals per match. Null before 2014/15.

football_teams.name: football_teams
football_teams.description: Spanish football clubs competing in La Liga (1st division) or La Liga 2 (2nd division). Each document represents a unique team identified by its Sofascore ID.

sofascore_id.description: Unique numeric team identifier from Sofascore

league.description: Current or most recent division: 'La Liga' or 'La Liga 2'

name.description: Full official club name (e.g. 'Real Madrid CF')

updated_at.description: Last time this document was updated by the scraper

profile.longBusinessSummary: The index measures the performance of the total U.S. investment-grade bond market. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and TBAs that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index.

holdings.holdingName: BlackRock Cash Funds Instl SL Agency

profile.longBusinessSummary: The fund employs an indexing investment approach by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the common stocks included in the FTSE Developed Europe All Cap Index. The index is a market-capitalization-weighted index.

The advisor attempts to track the index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets-either directly or indirectly through a wholly owned subsidiary, which is itself a registered investment company-in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index. The fund is non-diversified.

The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the performance of the large- and mid-capitalization segments of the equity market in Spain. The fund is non-diversified.

holdings.holdingName: Industria De Diseno Textil SA Share From Split
ACS Actividades de Construccion y Servicios SA

profile.longBusinessSummary: To maintain the correspondence between the composition and weights of the securities in the trust (the "securities") and the stocks in the NASDAQ-100 Index®, the adviser adjusts the securities from time to time to conform to periodic changes in the identity and/or relative weights of index securities. The composition and weighting of the securities portion of a portfolio deposit are also adjusted to conform to changes in the index.

The trust seeks to achieve its investment objective by holding a portfolio of the common stocks that are included in the index (the “Portfolio”), with the weight of each stock in the Portfolio substantially corresponding to the weight of such stock in the index.

The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which represents approximately 100% of the investable U.S. stock market and includes large-, mid-, small-, and micro-cap stocks regularly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq. It invests by sampling the index, meaning that it holds a broadly diversified collection of securities that, in the aggregate, approximates the full index in terms of key characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.

The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is designed to measure equity market performance in the global emerging markets. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.

The investment objective of the Trust is for the Shares to reflect the performance of the price of gold bullion, less the Trust’s expenses. summaries.name: football_players
summaries.description: Professional football players who appeared in La Liga or La Liga 2 between 2005/06 and 2024/25. One document per unique player.

summaries.name: football_standings
summaries.description: PRIMARY collection for historical classification queries. Final league standings per team per season: 'points', 'rank' (final position), 'wins', 'draws', 'losses', 'goals_scored', 'goals_conceded'. Covers La Liga 14/15 to 24/25 and Segunda División 14/15 to 22/23 (418 documents total). Use for: points by season, league position history, team performance over years. Filter teams by 'team_name' field using $in.

summaries.name: football_player_stats
summaries.description: Season-total goals and assists ONLY for top La Liga scorers (23/24 and 24/25). Has player_id but NO name field. ALWAYS pair with football_players collection to get player names via $lookup on player_id=sofascore_id. Only goals and assists have real data — all other stats are 0 or NULL.

summaries.name: football_odds
summaries.description: Bet365 pre-match odds (home_odds, draw_odds, away_odds) per match. Links to football_matches via match_id=sofascore_id. 8264 documents covering La Liga 14/15 to 24/25. IMPORTANT: To correlate odds with team standings or team names, you MUST join through football_matches first (odds.match_id → matches.sofascore_id), then group by home_team_name to get team identity. Never join football_odds directly to football_standings.

summaries.name: football_matches
summaries.description: PRIMARY collection for match-level analysis. 8719 individual match records for La Liga and La Liga 2 (2005/06, 2014/15 to 2024/25). Contains: scores (home_score, away_score), half-time scores, shots, corners, fouls, yellow/red cards, and xG (home_xg, away_xg — available for La Liga 22/23, 23/24, 24/25 only). Use this collection for: xG analysis, cards/fouls trends, home vs away performance, comeback analysis, shots per game, and any per-match statistics. For xG overperformance (goals vs expected), group by home_team_name and compare sum(home_score) vs sum(home_xg).

summaries.name: football_team_stats
summaries.description: VERY LIMITED and mostly empty: Only 40 documents (23/24 and 24/25 La Liga). Does NOT have 'points'. total_xg, xg_per_match, avg_ball_possession, total_shots, shots_on_target are NULL in ALL 40 documents — NEVER use for xG queries. For xG analysis use football_matches. For points/standings use football_standings. Avoid this collection.

summaries.name: football_teams
summaries.description: Spanish football clubs competing in La Liga (1st division) or La Liga 2 (2nd division). Each document represents a unique team identified by its Sofascore ID.
